description: This PHP source file defines the 'Store' class within the 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Setting' namespace. The class manages CRUD operations for store entities, including adding, updating, deleting, and retrieving store records in an OpenCart e-commerce system. Additionally, it contains a method to create a complete store instance with all necessary dependencies and configurations.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Represents store management with methods for CRUD operations and store instance creation within the OpenCart admin model.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Creates a new store record in the database and initializes related layout and SEO URL routes.

methods.name: editStore
methods.description: Updates an existing store record identified by store ID.

methods.name: deleteStore
methods.description: Removes a store and all associated data, including categories, products, SEO URLs, and settings.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Retrieves the data of a specific store by store ID, returning default data for store ID 0.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Fetches a list of all stores, with optional pagination.

methods.name: getTotalStores
methods.description: Returns the total number of store records.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByLayoutId
methods.description: Counts how many stores use a specific layout ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByLanguage
methods.description: Counts stores configured with a specific language.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByCurrency
methods.description: Counts stores configured with a specific currency.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByCountryId
methods.description: Counts stores associated with a specific country ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByZoneId
methods.description: Counts stores associated with a specific zone ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByCustomerGroupId
methods.description: Counts stores associated with a specific customer group ID.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByInformationId
methods.description: Counts stores associated with specific informational pages.

methods.name: getTotalStoresByOrderStatusId
methods.description: Counts stores associated with a specific order status.

methods.name: createStoreInstance
methods.description: Instantiates a full store environment with all dependencies and configurations, given a store ID and language.
